process_area.title: Kit & Bundle Definition, BOM & Build Planning

fields.Participants: Category Mgr, Merchandising Planning, Marketing, Supply Chain
fields.Volume: Kit/Bundle item type (model company §6.4); seasonal programs

workflows.name: Kit & Bundle Product Strategy, Definition & Lifecycle

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-document of "approve kit concept, target customer, channel" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-505 (ensure controlled execution — Kit & Bundle Definition, BOM & Build Planning (PA-92.1).)
- operational: basket analysis and test builds
Pain Points / Risks: - **Demand-misjudgment risk**: Kits built without demand tie up components; mitigated by basket analysis and test builds
System Touchpoints: - Merchandising/assortment planning (links to VS-01); basket analytics (links to VS-28)

steps.activity: Category Manager identifies kit/bundle opportunities (contractor combo packs, bathroom/kitchen complete sets, tool sets, seasonal starter kits) from basket analysis and customer input
Merchandising Planning defines kit type: pre-packaged kit (built at DC/vendor), virtual bundle (price-only, components sold together), or display bundle (assembled at store)
Merchandising/Marketing approve kit concept, target customer, channel (in-store/ecommerce), and lifecycle (seasonal vs. evergreen); document strategy

fields.Participants: Merchandising Planner, Supply Chain, IT/Master Data

workflows.name: Kit Bill of Materials (BOM), Component Mapping & Yield Definition

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-validate of "validates component availability" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-flag of "flags single-source constraints" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-log of "IT/Master Data configures kit BOM in ERP" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-505 (ensure controlled execution — Kit & Bundle Definition, BOM & Build Planning (PA-92.1).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **BOM-accuracy risk**: Wrong components/quantities cause build errors; mitigated by validation and testing
System Touchpoints: - Kit BOM in ERP; item master (links to VS-29); cost roll-up engine

steps.activity: Merchandising Planner defines BOM: component SKUs, quantities, substitute components, and yield (kits per component set); validates component availability
Supply Chain validates component sourcing and lead time; flags single-source constraints; confirms build feasibility across DCs
IT/Master Data configures kit BOM in ERP (phantom vs. stocked kit); sets component linkage and consumption logic; tests cost roll-up

workflows.name: Bundle Pricing, Margin Validation & Component Cost Roll-Up

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-validate of "validates target margin vs." (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-review of "review margin and cannibalization risk" (replaces manual Step 2).
Controls: - CTL-505 (ensure controlled execution — Kit & Bundle Definition, BOM & Build Planning (PA-92.1).)
- operational: cost roll-up and margin floor
Pain Points / Risks: - **Margin-erosion risk**: Bundle priced below component cost or with vendor-funded components unaccounted; mitigated by cost roll-up and margin floor
System Touchpoints: - Product costing (links to W85); price book (links to W40/VS-01); margin validation

steps.activity: Pricing Analyst rolls up component landed cost to kit standard cost; compares to bundle price; validates target margin vs. category margin floor
Finance/Pricing review margin and cannibalization risk (bundle vs. component standalone); approve price or adjust
Marketing/Pricing set promotional price tiers, quantity breaks, and channel price where applicable; configure in price book (links to W40)

workflows.name: Kit/Bundle Master Data, SKU Setup & Configuration

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-create of "creates kit SKU with attributes" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-validate of "Ecommerce/Master Data publish kit to channels" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-505 (ensure controlled execution — Kit & Bundle Definition, BOM & Build Planning (PA-92.1).)
- operational: item-master governance and test transactions
Pain Points / Risks: - **Master-data risk**: Kit misconfigured leads to wrong inventory/price behavior; mitigated by item-master governance and test transactions
System Touchpoints: - Item master (links to VS-29); ecommerce/marketplace catalog (links to VS-10/VS-65); kit configuration

steps.activity: Master Data creates kit SKU with attributes (item type Kit/Bundle, weight, dimensions, hazmat, images, category, tax) per item-master standards (links to VS-29)
Master Data/IT configure kit behavior: stocked kit (inventory at kit SKU), virtual bundle (price-only, deduct components at sale), or assembly order kit
Ecommerce/Master Data publish kit to channels (web/app/marketplace) with bundle imagery, component list, and SEO content; validate listing (links to VS-10/VS-65)

fields.Participants: Supply Planning, Merchandising, DC Ops, Procurement

workflows.name: Component Availability, Allocation & Build Feasibility Planning

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-validate of "checks component availability across DCs" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-flag of "flags kit at-risk if component constrained" (replaces manual Step 2).
Controls: - CTL-505 (ensure controlled execution — Kit & Bundle Definition, BOM & Build Planning (PA-92.1).)
- operational: allocation rules and substitute components
Pain Points / Risks: - **Component-constraint risk**: Kit starves when one component is short; mitigated by allocation rules and substitute components
System Touchpoints: - Supply planning/ATP (links to VS-02); component allocation; procurement (links to VS-03)

steps.activity: Supply Planning checks component availability across DCs; allocates components to kit builds vs. standalone sale based on margin/priority
Procurement expedites short components or secures additional vendor supply; flags kit at-risk if component constrained
Merchandising/Supply Planning decide build plan: build quantity, location (DC vs. store), and timing aligned to demand and seasonal phase-in

fields.Participants: Merchandising Planning, Marketing, Supply Chain, DC Ops

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-schedule of "schedule build waves to hit phase-in dates with components pre-positioned" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-schedule of "transitions post-season per VS-64 clearance" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-505 (ensure controlled execution — Kit & Bundle Definition, BOM & Build Planning (PA-92.1).)
- operational: build-wave scheduling and component pre-positioning
Pain Points / Risks: - **Timing risk**: Kits late to phase-in miss peak demand; mitigated by build-wave scheduling and component pre-positioning
System Touchpoints: - Seasonal planning (links to VS-64); replenishment (links to VS-02); promotion (links to VS-14)

steps.activity: Merchandising Planning plans seasonal kit portfolio against seasonal calendar (links to VS-64); defines phase-in/phase-out timing and target build quantities
Supply Chain/DC Ops schedule build waves to hit phase-in dates with components pre-positioned; align to replenishment cycles
Marketing coordinates promotional kit launch, pricing, and feature placement; transitions post-season per VS-64 clearance

fields.Participants: Private Label Mgr, Merchandising, Vendor Mgmt, Quality, Marketing
fields.Trigger: Private-label or vendor co-branded kit initiative

Automation Opportunity: - System workflow orchestration of "coordinate kit development with manufacturer" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-validate of "validates component and packaging quality, safety, and certification per W447" (replaces manual Step 2).
Controls: - CTL-505 (ensure controlled execution — Kit & Bundle Definition, BOM & Build Planning (PA-92.1).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Compliance risk**: Private-label kit fails certification; mitigated by Quality gate per W447
System Touchpoints: - Private-label program (links to VS-41); vendor portal (links to VS-03); artwork/asset management

steps.activity: Private Label Manager/Vendor Mgmt coordinate kit development with manufacturer: components, packaging, branding, labeling compliant with DTI-BPS (links to VS-41)
Quality validates component and packaging quality, safety, and certification per W447; approves vendor QA process for kit build
Merchandising/Marketing finalize private-label kit pricing, packaging artwork, and go-to-market; coordinate with VS-41 brand management

fields.Participants: Merchandising Planning, Supply Chain, DC Ops, Pricing, Finance

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-reconcile of "reconciles write-down and component recovery value" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-76 (ensure kit build & component inventory integrity.)
- operational: sell-through plan and tear-down recovery
Pain Points / Risks: - **Stranded-inventory risk**: Kits and components left unsold post-discontinuation; mitigated by sell-through plan and tear-down recovery
System Touchpoints: - Discontinuation/clearance (links to VS-64); tear-down order (W3078); inventory recovery

steps.activity: Merchandising Planning decides discontinuation; stops new builds and replenishment; plans sell-through of finished kits and component recovery
Pricing/Marketing execute clearance markdown on remaining kit inventory (links to VS-64); DC Ops/Store Ops clear shelf and ecommerce listing
DC Ops tear down unsold kits per W3078, returning components to saleable stock; Finance reconciles write-down and component recovery value
